description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of content categories across a dataset, with each slice representing a distinct category and its corresponding proportion of the total. The largest segment, labeled "People Blogs," accounts for 17.2% of the data and is visually represented by an orange-colored slice. The second-largest category, "Entertainment," makes up 13.9% and is shown in purple. "Education" follows with 8.7%, depicted in red. Other notable categories include "Howto" at 9.7% (green), "Sports" at 6.4% (pink), and "Comedy" at 5.6% (light blue). Smaller segments include "Gaming" (4.6%, grey), "Film Animation" (4.6%, brown), "Travel Events" (4.3%, yellow), "Science Technology" (6.4%, dark blue), "News Politics" (3.9%, teal), "Pets Animals" (4.8%, light green), "Autos Vehicles" (2.3%, very light purple), and "Music" (2.3%, lavender). The chart includes percentage labels within each slice, and the categories are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top. The slices vary in size according to their proportions, with no visual emphasis such as exploded segments.
